title: BeCALM - Brentuximab vedotin in CutAneous T-cell Lymphomas (CTCL): post-allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant Maintenance
official: BeCALM - Brentuximab vedotin in CutAneous T-cell Lymphomas (CTCL): post-allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant Maintenance
summary: Main objective: The main objective is to compare the progression-free survival rate post alloHSCT in the BV group compared to placebo.
conditions: Neoplasms benign malignant and unspecified (incl cysts and polyps)

interventions.name: ADCETRIS 50 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. (i) Age ≥ 18 and ≤ 70 years
2. (ix) Adequate renal function: creatinine clearance calculated by Cockcroft & Gault formula of ≥ 50 mL/min
3. (ii) Histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of ISCL-EORTC stage IIB, III, IVA or IVB MF (mycosis fungoides) with ≥1% CD30 expression determined by immunohistochemistry
4. (iv) Relapsed or refractory to at least one line of systemic treatment
5. (v) Complete or partial response of the lymphoma at the time of study inclusion
6. (vi) Having received recent alloHSCT from a sibling, 10/10 or 9/10 phenoidentical, or haploidentical donor (60 to 90 days before inclusion)
7. (x) Patient affiliated to life insurance
8. (xi) Written informed consent given by the patient
9. (iii) ECOG performance status 0-1
10. (vii) Adequate liver function: • Total bilirubin ≤ 2 xULN, or Direct bilirubin ≤ 2xULN if total bilirubin is >2xULN, or total bilirubin >2 xULN if elevated total bilirubin is attributed to Gilbert’s syndrome • Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 3 x ULN (viii) Adequate hematological function: • Absolute neutrophil count of ≥ 1.0 G/L • Platelet count of ≥ 50 G/L • Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
Exclusion criteria:
1. (i) Second or higher allogeneic HSCT
2. (x) Pregnant and/or breastfeeding women
3. (xi) Participation to another interventional clinical trial
4. (xii) Adults subject to a legal protection measure (guardianship, curatorship and safeguard of justice
5. (xiii) Patients deprived of their liberty by a judicial or administrative decision
6. (ii) Other progressive neoplastic or psychotic disease
7. (iii) Left ventricular ejection fraction < 50%, carbone monoxide diffusion capacity < 50% of the theoretical value
8. (iv) History of BV-induced adverse event without resolution to current grade <2. Previous treatment with brentuximab  vedotin alone, in the absence of current ≥ grade 2 BV-induced side effect, is NOT an exclusion criterion
9. (v) History of disease refractoriness, progression or relapse during BV treatment. Previous       treatment with BV alone, if the disease was treatment-sensitive (complete, partial response or stable disease), is NOT an exclusion criterion.
10. (vi) History of ≥ grade 4 adverse event induced by BV. Previous 
11. (vii) Contra-indication to BV including current >grade 2 neutropenia or active infection
12. (viii) Progressive disease or relapse at study inclusion compared to the screening visit status
13. (ix) Refusal of two highly effective birth control methods for female participant of childbearing potential and male participant with a female partner of childbearing potential
